newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares inch up on institutional support.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares inch up on institutional support.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index inched to a higher close on Friday with market sentiment helped by institutional buying of a handful of issues with solid earnings records, brokers said.
The B share index inched up 0.09 points, or 0.10 percent, to close at 89.89 on turnover of HK$17.99 million, compared with HK$16.83 million on Thursday.
The B share advance was fueled in part by rises in low-priced counters which appeared undervalued at current levels, brokers said.
